title: Built-in exercise catalogue (v1)
description: Static list of built-in exercises, shipped with the app and API. Workouts and routines reference an entry as exercise_id "builtin:<slug>". Slugs are permanent: deprecate entries, never delete or rename a slug. Any change bumps catalogue_version.

catalogue_version.description: Incremented on every change to the catalogue (add, deprecate, rename a display name, change muscles or tracking).

slug.description: Permanent identifier. Referenced as builtin:<slug>. Lowercase words joined by hyphens; equipment first where it matters (dumbbell-bench-press).

deprecated.description: Hidden from pickers for new routines and workouts. Existing references keep resolving.
